title: Audio/video captions and transcripts
learningObjectives: Explain audio/video captions and transcripts and apply inclusive web accessibility practices.

understand.concept: Audio and video content should provide appropriate alternatives such as captions, transcripts, and audio descriptions where needed. The track element can reference timed text tracks, including captions and subtitles. Captions include relevant speech and meaningful non-speech audio.
understand.whyItMatters: Captions and transcripts make media usable for people who are deaf or hard of hearing and help others understand content in noisy or quiet environments. Do not rely on auto-generated captions without review.
understand.analogy: Captions are the written companion to spoken and meaningful sound; a transcript is the complete text version of the media content.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; accessible names, language, and interaction behaviour must follow platform accessibility rules.

explain.narrative: The video provides an English caption track and a separate transcript link. The referenced files must exist and contain accurate text.

practise.guidedTask: Add captions and a transcript to a sample video. Explain when an audio description is also needed.
practise.independentTask: Perform an accessibility review of a small page. Test keyboard-only use, labels, language metadata, media alternatives, and assistive technology output where available.
hints: Keep ARIA states synchronized with real interface state.
Provide text alternatives for meaningful non-text content.

questions.prompt: Which element adds a timed text track to audio or video?
questions.explanation: The track element references captions, subtitles, and other timed text tracks.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest baseline for accessible HTML?
options: Semantic native HTML, clear labels, keyboard support, and testing
questions.answer: Semantic native HTML, clear labels, keyboard support, and testing
questions.explanation: Accessibility starts with semantic structure and working interactions, then uses ARIA only where needed.
